Title: Broken db import in user/listings API
Description: Imports { db } which doesn't exist in firebase-admin.js. Should be getAdminFirestore().

Title: Broken db import in user/messages/count API
Nav bar overlap - Noticeboard hidden by geolocation button
Description: The 'Show listings near me' geolocation button overlaps the 'Noticeboard' nav link intercepting pointer events. Clicking Noticeboard actually clicks the geo button. Fix: Added pr-16 and z-10 to nav container.

Title: Marketplace category tabs don't filter results
Description: Switching category tabs changes the heading text but items remain identical. Fix: Pass subcategory param to API and add server-side category filtering.

Title: The Hub main page renders blank
Description: Navigating to /the-hub renders an empty <main> tag with no content. Cause: Used server-only redirect() in client component. Fix: Replaced with router.replace().

Title: Post Ad page stuck redirect for unauthenticated users
Description: Shows 'Redirecting to dashboard...' but never actually redirects to /login for unauthenticated users. Fix: Added auth check, unauth users redirected to login.

Title: Excessive Fast Refresh rebuilds and Long Task warnings
Description: Console showed Long Task detected warnings from duplicate PerformanceObservers. Fix: Made Long Task monitoring production-only and added guards against duplicate observers on Fast Refresh. Fast Refresh messages are Turbopack-internal (unfixable).

Title: No validation on empty registration form submit
Description: Clicking 'Create Account' with all fields empty shows no validation error. Fix: Added explicit empty field checks (email, password, confirmPassword) before form submission.

Title: Verify email 'Skip for now' creates redirect loop
Description: 'Skip for now' link on /verify-email points to /dashboard which redirects unverified users back to /verify-email creating an infinite redirect loop. Fix: Changed href from /dashboard to /.

Title: Raw Firebase error shown on invalid login
Description: Invalid login shows raw 'Firebase: Error (auth/invalid-login-credentials).' instead of user-friendly message. Fix: Added getAuthErrorMessage() mapper in AuthContext for all Firebase auth error codes.

Title: Hub admin page accessible to unauthenticated users
Description: Admin-related bug - excluded from this fix batch per instructions.

Title: Property type filter (rent/sale) ignored by API
Description: The type query parameter is ignored. Fix: Added fallback to read 'type' param when 'listingType' is absent.

Title: Inconsistent redirect param names across pages
Description: /profile redirects to /login?returnUrl=/profile while other pages use 'redirect'. Fix: Changed profile to use 'redirect' param.

Title: Garbled Unicode emoji in listing addresses
Description: UTF-8 mojibake in Firestore data (emoji bytes stored as Latin-1 chars). Fix: Created fixEncoding.js utility and applied fixListingEncoding() to all properties API routes. Also created scripts/fix-encoding.js for permanent Firestore data migration.

Title: User API endpoints return 400 instead of 401 for unauthenticated
Description: These endpoints return 400 Bad Request instead of 401 Unauthorized when no auth token is provided. Fix: Added verifyAuth() check before userId validation.

Title: Hub communities API uses inconsistent response format
Description: Returns { communities } shape while all other listing APIs use { success data pagination } format. Fix: Added success/data/pagination fields to empty response.
